description_md:
## Earn Bitcoin at AliExpress

AliExpress is the global marketplace for low-cost electronics and just about everything else. Buy through Satsback and you get up to 2.7% of your order value back in Bitcoin, paid as sats to a Lightning wallet you control.

If AliExpress is already on your shopping list, routing the order through Satsback is free money on spending you'd do regardless — this page covers the current rate, how the tracking really works, and whether it's worth the extra step for a marketplaces purchase.
how_it_works_md:
## How AliExpress Bitcoin cashback works

1. Create a free Satsback account (no KYC required) and add the browser extension.
2. Open AliExpress through Satsback — the extension prompts you to activate rewards with one click.
3. Shop and check out as normal. Your cashback (up to 2.7%) shows as *pending* in your Satsback dashboard.
4. After AliExpress confirms the sale, the sats become withdrawable to any Bitcoin Lightning wallet.

**Tracking caveat — worth reading.** Satsback depends on affiliate tracking, and users report roughly two out of three orders track cleanly (it sits around 3.2/5 on the Chrome Web Store). To give yourself the best odds: disable ad-blockers on the AliExpress tab, don't run other coupon or cashback extensions at checkout, and make the Satsback tab the last thing you touch before paying. If an order doesn't appear within a few days, Satsback support can chase it with your receipt.
worth_it_md:
## Is it worth it?

The rate is solid for marketplaces; on a normal-sized AliExpress order it adds up to a worthwhile chunk of sats.

Two things to weigh: the reward is Bitcoin, so its fiat value moves with BTC — a plus if you're stacking long-term, a variable if you're not. And Satsback rarely stacks with AliExpress's own loyalty program on the same order, so compare the two and use whichever pays more.

faqs.question: How much Bitcoin do I earn at AliExpress?
faqs.answer_md: Currently up to 2.7%, credited in sats to your Satsback dashboard once AliExpress confirms the order.

faqs.question: Do I need to verify my identity (KYC) to earn?
faqs.answer_md: No. Satsback is free and requires no KYC — you only need an account and the browser extension to earn Bitcoin at AliExpress.

faqs.question: When can I withdraw my AliExpress cashback?
faqs.answer_md: Once the order moves from *pending* to *confirmed* (after AliExpress's return window closes), your sats are withdrawable to any Bitcoin Lightning wallet.
